title: Logistics Coordinator
summary: A Logistics Coordinator gets goods from the warehouse or plant to customers on time, planning dispatches, booking trucks with transporters and preparing documents such as e-way bills (the GST permit for moving goods). They sit in the logistics or supply chain team and work with warehouses, transporters, sales and accounts.
dailyDuties: Plan daily dispatches and place vehicles with transporters
Generate e-way bills, invoices and delivery challans
Track shipments and collect proof of delivery
Coordinate loading and stock transfers with the warehouse
Check freight bills against agreed rates
Prepare import and export documents with forwarders and CHAs
Update the dispatch tracker and share daily MIS

skills.expectation: Plan daily dispatches and track shipments to proof of delivery
Prepare e-way bills, delivery challans and dispatch documents
Verify freight bills and keep freight costs in check
Coordinate loading, inbound receipts and stock transfers with the warehouse
Handle basic import and export documents and work with CHAs
Maintain dispatch trackers and MIS reports in spreadsheets
Report OTIF and freight cost trends
Create deliveries and pull reports from the ERP
Understand GST rules behind dispatch documents
Keep customers, sales and transporters informed
Resolve delays, damages and vehicle shortages
